description: Before applying a code change, return a deterministic safety report. Checks for broken imports, new circular dependencies, health score impact, and runs a targeted scan on changed files. Used by AI coding assistants and autonomous agents.

depwire_action_token.description: Optional, reserved for future DAT integration

file_path.description: File path being changed (use with new_content)

new_content.description: The proposed new content of the file

unified_diff.description: A unified diff string (alternative to file_path + new_content)

name: verify_change
